question: A network engineer configures a converged network adapter (CNA) and must associate a virtual Fibre Channel 7 interface to VSAN 7. The CNA is connected to the interface Eth1/7, and VLAN 700 is mapped to the VSAN. Which configuration must be applied to create the virtual Fibre Channel interface and associate it with the Ethernet physical interface?
options:
switch(config)# interface vfc 7
switch(config-if)# bind interface ethernet 1/7

switch(config)# vsan database
switch(config-vsan)# vsan 7 interface vfc 7

switch(config)# interface ethernet 1/7
switch(config-if)# vfc 7 attach vlan 1,700
theory: To connect a converged network adapter's FCoE traffic into a specific VSAN, you first create the virtual Fibre Channel interface (here vfc 7) and then bind it directly to the physical Ethernet interface the CNA is attached to ('bind interface ethernet 1/7'); this binding, not a VLAN or VSAN database command by itself, is what ties the logical FC interface to the physical link so FCoE frames can be forwarded correctly, after which VLAN-to-VSAN mapping and VSAN interface membership complete the picture. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 9 - FCoE Implementation)
